decision: Selected the area centroid of the application-site polygon that Cherwell District Council's public planning register map service publishes for reserved matters approval 25/03310/REM (the same polygon it holds for outline permission 22/01829/OUT) as the project locator for the eight-unit Graven Hill D1 data-centre campus. The centroid was computed in British National Grid and converted to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1. It is a site marker inside the consented boundary, not a building footprint or surveyed position.

selected_properties.service: Cherwell District Council, Cherwell Public Planning Register map service (layer 0, Planning Applications), linked from the council's planning register page and its 'Cherwell Public Planning Register' web map
selected_properties.feature: OBJECTID 77943, application 25/03310/REM, location 'Unit D1 Graven Hill, Circular Road, Ambrosden', status Permitted, decision 2026-08-06
selected_properties.same_polygon_as: OBJECTID 69207 (outline 22/01829/OUT, permitted 2023-10-10) and OBJECTID 79754 (pending alternative reserved matters 26/02446/REM)
selected_properties.polygon: one ring, 102 vertices, valid, area 323,338.6 m2 (32.3 ha; the officer report gives 32.3 ha), perimeter 4,074.5 m; it includes the constructed access road corridor north-east to the A41 roundabout

transform.method: shapely 2.1.1 Polygon.centroid of the service ring in EPSG:27700, then pyproj 3.7.1 Transformer.from_crs('EPSG:27700', 'EPSG:4326', always_xy=True)

consistency_checks.inside_polygon: The centroid lies inside the polygon, 190.2 m from its nearest edge.
consistency_checks.application_form_point: The applicant's planning application form for 25/03310/REM (Planning Portal PP-14036983) gives the site location as easting 459219, northing 219802 (51.8736541, -1.1412278 after the same transform), 59.0 m from the centroid and inside the same polygon.
consistency_checks.site_description: The officer report describes 32.3 ha of former MOD land south of the Graven Hill residential area and St David's Barracks, bounded by the MOD railway and a solar farm to the south and west and farmland to the east, with the Employment Access Road along the northern boundary linking to Pioneer Road and the A41.
consistency_checks.imagery: Esri World Imagery z16 tiles (x 32559-32561, y 21682-21685) viewed locally with the polygon overlaid and not redistributed: the polygon encloses the cleared former depot (demolished building slabs and yards) between the railway and a large solar farm to the south-west, plus the access-road corridor to the A41 roundabout; the centroid falls inside the main cleared site. The imagery date is unknown and is not used as status evidence.

uncertainty: The point is a computed centroid of the application boundary, which covers the whole 32.3 ha site and its access-road corridor; individual data-centre units lie up to several hundred metres from it, and the council publishes no positional accuracy for the boundary.
